title: Verax live artifact provenance
sourceSummary: Preview data is a compact local sample dataset representing image, video, audio, and webpage/social-post audits.
transformationNotes: Normalized each sample into label, media type, source, audit score, status, finding, and verification path.
Added separate ledger and policy screens while keeping app and bookmarklet surfaces split.
Expanded result detail states for image, video, audio, and text audit previews.
Shifted copy to a neutral-arbiter infrastructure voice.
Excluded user media, private auth material, provider output envelopes, and sensitive fields.
refreshNotes: Future refreshes should update data.json only; template.html preserves the presentation and interaction structure.
